item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyud ma mo 'bum bskul stong gsum g.yo byed
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas rab brtan phag lo'i zla tshes nyin par/ ka ke'u seng ge'i yang rdzong nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi g.yon phyogs/ saM ha la ke'u tshang gong ma nas d+ha k+ki karma la grogs bcas te spyan drangs shing / slar zla tshes la bsod nams can sa skyong bstan 'dzin pho brang drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbus rtse nas/ shog ser bod yig tu bsgyur ba 'grub pa bgyis shing 'phrin las thogs med du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
